keepWords: Keep everything else in image 1 exactly as it is: the same piano, bench, dais, wall, window and drapes, the same pixel art, the same camera and the same colours.

key.prompt: Image 1 is part of a pixel art game background at night: a black grand piano on a dark wooden dais, with a small black bench in front of its keyboard. Add one woman pianist sitting on that bench with her back to the viewer, playing the piano. She is a slim, elegant, upright woman of about sixty with a sleek chin-length silver bob, in a long-sleeved black velvet evening gown with a narrow champagne-gold sash at the waist, its skirt falling to the dais, drawn with a thick dark ink outline in the same crisp pixel art as the picture. Her head is turned a little to the left so a sliver of her profile shows, both elbows are bent and her hands rest on the keys in front of her, out of sight. She sits on the bench at the size the bench and piano allow.
